evidence_reuse.qualification: Final art changes from period03/04 are only female MD3 walk/run frames2..7: positions change in3/5/6/7;2/4 retain exact positions/bounds and differ only in a few encoded normals after floating-point gait transforms. Final-package female visual checks and final presentation cohorts complement this bounded functional reuse; no campaign or author acceptance.

iterations: Initial joint witnesses, collar/sash/button intersections and duplicated death endpoints were corrected; earlier geometry diagnostics remain.

Refined face atlas preserves complete chins; a second finer cloth strip corrects oversized visible patterning. Every generated original remains unchanged, including the unused initial atlas. The edited atlas does not claim identity of untouched cells.

Native inspection led to shorter crania, closed crown/temple hair, a mourning collar, scooped Llorona neckline/flared sleeves and ten toes. These are visual source dimensions, not balance or metric scale adoption.

Closed meshes and rooted joints did not catch legs penetrating skirts. Waist-anchored skirt expansion and a gentler visual stride correct the observed protrusions. Independent serialized triangle coverage now contains all1488 above-hem leg-vertex samples in the two extreme poses. Superseded stride captures remain.

Binary audit bounds reused native evidence: only female walk/run frames2..7 differ from period03/04;2/4 differ only in a few encoded normals with exact positions/bounds. Futre is unchanged since period02. Final female visual checks and all final-package presentation pairs complement the reuse.
reviewed: Final front/side/rear, face/hair/neck/collar details, extreme strides, attack, pain, intermediate death and oblique rest views; both presentation scenes per species.
qualifications: Stylized closed component anatomy, painted facial detail, opaque hair and rigid fall/rest poses remain author-review candidates. Clothing is fixed species art, not equipped modular inventory.
